title: Test money utils
skill: Name the structure and the cases you want tested

good: Create tests/test_money.py for money.py with unittest. Start it like tests/test_smoke.py (sys.path insert). Use exactly three TestCase classes, one per function. AddTest: add('1.10', '2.20') == Decimal('3.30'); add('1', '2', '3', '4') == Decimal('10.00'); add('0.125') == Decimal('0.13') (half up); add(0.1, '1.00') raises TypeError. SplitTest: split('10.00', 3) == [Decimal('3.34'), Decimal('3.33'), Decimal('3.33')]; sum(split('100.00', 7)) == Decimal('100.00'). FormatTest: format_usd('1234.5') == '$1,234.50'; format_usd('-5') == '-$5.00'. Do not change money.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
